visualCharacteristics: A document news feed: a row of category filter tabs and a Sort By dropdown above a list of document rows (linked title + publication date). A 'Load More' button paginates the list. Filtering, sorting (Newest/Oldest/A-Z/Z-A), and pagination are client-side.
contentPattern: One row per document with three cells: linked document title, publication date, and category. The block derives the filter tabs from the distinct category values.
usage: Provider news / bulletin archives with filter, sort, and load-more behavior.
